comment.text: PIM1 S97 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v2. Source observations include Hematologic neoplasms; Lymphoid neoplasms. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.

Tumor counts describe source cohorts and may overlap between releases and sheets; they must not be added together.
An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.
